findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the Approach's reference wording and the AC1 grep string agree: either name the exact target sentence (e.g. 'committed on `origin/main`', as in manifest-signing.md:43 and the runbook) or change AC1 to grep for the plan-review-gate.md phrase 'committed on the reviewed base branch (`origin/main`)'.
evidence: Plan Approach: 'Wording matches `docs/plan-review-gate.md` (the op-cert quote block) so the 2 pages agree.'
Plan AC1: 'grep -n "committed on `origin/main`" docs/llm-framework.md prints a line in that paragraph.'

docs/plan-review-gate.md:1924-1926: 'The gate reads its `[verify]` settings from the project config / committed on the reviewed base branch (`origin/main`), along with `tracker.dir`, never from / the checkout under review, so a change cannot widen the trust of its own gate run.'
The literal 'committed on `origin/main`' appears only in infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md:99 and docs/manifest-signing.md:43. It does not appear in plan-review-gate.md.
findings.finding: The plan says its wording will match the op-cert quote block in docs/plan-review-gate.md, but that block does not contain the phrase AC1 greps for. plan-review-gate.md:1924-1925 reads 'reads its `[verify]` settings from the project config committed on the reviewed base branch (`origin/main`), along with `tracker.dir`'. AC1 checks `grep -n "committed on \`origin/main\`"`. If the author copies the reference wording as the Approach says, AC1 fails. If they write to satisfy AC1, the two pages no longer agree word for word. The plan takes for granted that the reference doc and the AC grep string agree, and they don't.
findings.location: Approach ('Wording matches `docs/plan-review-gate.md` (the op-cert quote block)') vs Acceptance Criteria AC1 grep
scenarios: The implementer copies the plan-review-gate.md sentence into llm-framework.md, AC1's grep returns nothing, and the verifier fails the ticket even though the doc is correct.
The implementer writes 'committed on `origin/main`' to pass AC1, the pages are no longer worded the same as promised, and a later reviewer flags the stated goal as unmet.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the Approach to: 'Wording matches docs/plan-review-gate.md's op-cert quote block (lines ~1924-1926): "The gate reads its `[verify]` settings from the project config committed on the reviewed base branch (`origin/main`), along with `tracker.dir`, never from the checkout under review, so a change cannot widen the trust of its own gate run."' Then change AC1 to `grep -n "committed on the reviewed base branch (\`origin/main\`)" docs/llm-framework.md`, and require the match to fall within lines of the Trust model paragraph.
